channel.title: Mediatrix — a Marian study library
channel.description: Revisions to the Mediatrix study library: sixteen hand-designed pages on Mary as Mediatrix and Co-Redemptrix, drawn from patristic, medieval, and magisterial witness.

item.title: Rosary Companion: the twenty mysteries
item.description: Twenty rosary mysteries with scriptural and patristic gloss for each.

item.title: Twenty-eight Old Testament types of Our Lady
item.description: The Burning Bush, the Ark, the Gate, the Tower: Marian types exegeted from the Old Testament.

item.title: Office of Readings: a Marian sourcebook
item.description: Fifteen second-readings drawn from the patristic and magisterial canon for the Marian feasts.

item.title: Three load-bearing New Testament Marian passages
item.description: Luke 1, John 2, and John 19, read with patristic care.

item.title: The Litany of Loreto: fifty-four titles, annotated
item.description: Each Marian invocation traced to its scriptural and patristic root.

item.title: The Library: twelve eras of Marian witness
item.description: From the early Fathers to Vatican II, Marian witness traced era by era.

item.title: Four canonical Marian icon-types with provenance
item.description: Hodegetria, Eleousa, Orans, and Theotokos enthroned: the four canonical Marian icon-types.

item.title: Eighteen Marian feasts of the liturgical year
item.description: Date, rank, history, and the proper of the day for the eighteen Marian feasts.

item.title: Marian devotional practices, in liturgical order
item.description: Consecration, scapular, medal, First Saturdays, Rosary, Angelus: eight Marian devotions with origin, form, and conditions.

item.title: Twelve Protestant objections, twelve patristic replies
item.description: Marian doctrinal defense drawn from the Fathers, structured objection by objection.

item.title: Concordance of Witnesses
item.description: A chronological concordance of the anthology's fifty-six Marian witnesses, with doctrinal pole, evidential provenance, and Wikidata/VIAF authority links.

item.title: The Threads of Witness
item.description: The fifty-six anthology witnesses re-gathered by doctrinal pole — Foundational, Co-Redemptrix, Mediatrix — and followed chronologically down the centuries.

item.title: Seven principal Church-approved apparitions
item.description: From Guadalupe to Akita: locus, message, and ecclesial recognition for the seven principal apparitions.

item.title: Anthology: forty-nine saints, in their own words
item.description: Forty-nine patristic, medieval, and magisterial voices on Mary, each with provenance and translation notes.

item.title: The Akathist Hymn: Greek and English facing
item.description: Twenty-four stanzas with the prooemion, in parallel Greek and English translation.

item.title: About: methodology and provenance
item.description: How quotations are tagged, sourced, and translated in the Mediatrix study library.
